final_message:
The issue has been fixed. The `wrap` function was incorrectly calculating whether a word would fit on the current line. The original code used `extra = len(w) + (1 if cur else 0)` and checked `len(cur) + extra > width - 1`, which didn't properly account for the space between words when they're already on the same line.

The fix changes the logic to simply check if `len(cur) + len(w) + 1 > width`, correctly accounting for both words and the single space character needed between them.
